title: Nicolas Cage bought a dinosaur skull and went broke
description:
Two castles, an island and a $276,000 dinosaur skull. None of it was money — and that is the whole lesson.

New video every day.

scenes.say: Nicolas Cage earned about a hundred and fifty million dollars. Then he told the world he owed the tax office fourteen million.
He had bought two castles in Europe. One for ten million, one for two point three.
And a dinosaur skull. Two hundred and seventy six thousand dollars, for a head with no body.
Here is the part that actually matters. None of that was money. A castle is not money. An island is not money. A skull is certainly not money.
They are things that cost money to keep. And when the bill arrives, you cannot pay it with a castle.
So he sold. In a hurry, to whoever was buying, at whatever they offered.
Rich is what you own. Liquid is what you can actually spend. Most money disasters live in the gap between them.
